Vortex TTS third-party notices

The bundled Arabic TTF files are Noto Sans Arabic font binaries used as an
offline-buildable fallback for the requested Vazirmatn UI family. They are
licensed by Google LLC under the Apache License 2.0. See
NOTO_SANS_ARABIC_LICENSE.txt.

The Vortex TTS source code itself is not bundled with an API key or backend
credential.
